summary: Full-stack E2E test of ASCAP Ditari (Albanian lesson-diary generator). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (admin login/CRUD, license activate validations, package mismatch, duplicate email, /license/me auth, deactivate -> 403, ditar auth & subject-not-in-license). Frontend: full UI flow via Playwright - admin modal, create 2-subject license, copy code, activate with 2 subjects, photo upload, AI generation (~18s, returned filled Albanian ditar with Tema auto-filled from JPEG), ditar modal, Word download triggered (Ditari_Matematikë_Klasa_5_04.10.2026.doc), archive list + open, wrong-code toast error. All data-testid selectors work.

issues: Field label uses .lbl class (lowercase in screenshot shows caps-styled) which is cosmetic only

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 2: load_dotenv called at import time - OK since env vars read via os.environ[] right after.
AdminModal: no logout for admin session (password re-prompted on reopen) - acceptable for MVP.

License /activate accepts package mismatch message in Albanian - good; but duplicate-email check uses .get('aktivizuar') AND email mismatch; if licensed teacher re-activates with same email it works (idempotent re-activate overwrites subjects) - may be intentional.
/ditar/generate does not validate klasa format or data format - minor.
No pagination for /ditar list (to_list(200)) or /admin/licenses (to_list(2000)) - acceptable scale.
DitarModal.save: mutates prop ditar.html directly - minor React anti-pattern.
test_credentials: Admin password: artikleo (header X-Admin-Password). Pre-existing active license ASCAP-GJZDFR-2315 (Biologji, t@t.com) was not used - test created fresh licenses to avoid polluting state. UI test created & activated ASCAP-TUAM0J-9889 (alban.ui@ascap.al, Matematikë + Gjuhë Shqipe).
seed_data_creation: 1 generated ditar persisted via UI test on license ASCAP-TUAM0J-9889 (Matematikë/Klasa 5, Tema 'Mbledhja dhe zbritja e thyesave me emërues të njëjtë'). Several test licenses created and deleted by pytest fixtures (teardown cleans them up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI generation uses gemini-3-flash-preview and succeeded in ~18s with real JPEG at /tmp/book_page.jpg (text-rendered book page). Credits consumed: 1 AI generation during UI test (backend tests skip the live /ditar/generate AI call per instructions). Run backend tests with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts='' --junitxml=...` because the project pytest.ini forces xdist LoadScopeScheduling which splits classes across workers and breaks the shared module-scoped license fixture.
